nodes.name: Enrich Trigger
nodes.notes: The QuickEnrich lane of Enrich Contacts (2026-09-09). Called once per launch with the whole company list; walks it in chunks of 100, asks QuickEnrich per chunk at its documented pace, hands each chunk to Enrich Contacts Writer (awaited), then writes its own Hub row "<parent execution>-quickenrich" and answers counters.

nodes.name: Chunk Loop
nodes.notes: One chunk at a time. Loop output: ask the vendor, write, tick. Done output: the lane row and the answer.

nodes.name: QE Roster
nodes.notes: QuickEnrich: the free roster of a domain (no emails, has_email flags and LinkedIn URLs). 120 requests a minute documented; paced at 120.

nodes.name: QE Email
nodes.notes: QuickEnrich: the email search per person (LinkedIn URL first, then name + domain), one credit only on a hit. 1,000 requests a minute documented; paced at about 850.

nodes.name: Call Writer
nodes.notes: Awaited. The writer merges this chunk into People and answers counters; a crash comes back as an error item and is counted, the lane moves to the next chunk.

nodes.name: Log Lane
nodes.notes: The lane's own Hub row, upsert on Execution ID "<parent execution>-quickenrich", Automation "Enrich Contacts QuickEnrich", Client attached. A failed write is not fatal: the counters still go back to the Rootflow.
